description: This walk takes you from Lewes to the coast at Seaford. The route runs for a distance of roughly 10 miles, following riverside footpaths and coastal trails in a south easterly direction. Starting in Lewes you head east to the River Ouse where you can pick up a fine riverside path. Follow it south and it will take you to Southease, passing the wildlife rich Railway Land Nature Reserve on the way. The route then continues to Newhaven where you pick up the coastal path and follow it south east to finish in Seaford.
